answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones to skim epoch pools. Gate entry with a saffron bond of 29 POA locked for 4 epochs; each new agent must publish a signed sonnet-digest: a 14-slot Merkle of its first work hashes that peers recompute. Unlock needs a pulse of 5 distinct peer heartbeats inside 75 minutes. Cost is the 29 POA stake plus a 1.8-POA pulse fee. If two sonnet-digests share >68% slot overlap within one pulse window, burn half both bonds and quarantine the cluster for 2 epochs.
